rules.statement: Each simulation records its seed.
The environment drives both clocks from one generator with related edges, including coincident edges, and varies the ratio (equal, 3:2, 2:3, 1:2, 2:1, 3:7, 7:3).
The software reset shall be verified on the RTL by TEST-009 and TEST-010, since prototype tests did not include it.

rules.condition: hardware reset asserted and released synchronously, including mid-traffic
rules.statement: All reset values are correct, the FIFO is empty after release, and no operation occurs before release (TEST-001).
Data is read in order with no loss or duplicate, and o_rd_data is valid whenever o_empty = 0 (TEST-002).
o_full rises in the cycle after the last place is filled, rejected writes give overflow pulses, and nothing is stored (TEST-003).

rules.condition: reading an empty FIFO or draining a FIFO
rules.statement: o_empty rises in the cycle after the last read, and rejected reads give underflow pulses (TEST-004).

rules.condition: thresholds swept from 0 to DEPTH while filling and draining
rules.statement: o_full_thr and o_empty_thr assert at the stated occupancy, and thresholds are static (TEST-005).

rules.condition: write into empty or read from full FIFO at several ratios and alignments
rules.statement: o_empty and o_full fall after the first or second strictly later edge (TEST-006).

rules.condition: continuous write and read, depth at least 4 + 2 x PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME
rules.statement: The side that is not rate-limited does not stall, and the table of Section 10.4 is reproduced (TEST-007).
Order and flags are correct at every wrap, and addresses stay within the depth (TEST-008).

rules.condition: equal and listed clock ratios, coincident edges, reset release at different phases
rules.statement: Behavior is correct for every ratio and no operation is lost at coincident edges (TEST-011).

rules.condition: same traffic with array and SRAM wrapper
rules.statement: Results and flag timing are identical for array and SRAM wrapper (TEST-012).

rules.condition: legal extremes: depth 2, 3 and large, data width 1 and large
rules.statement: Elaboration, lint and simulation pass (TEST-013).
Lint, rule check and port-list review show no violation; every flag, pulse and busy output is a flop (plus block gate) and no synchronizer exists (TEST-014).

rules.condition: STA with related clocks, several ratios, both pointer options
rules.statement: All crossing paths close, with no asynchronous clock group or false path between the clocks (TEST-015).
The scoreboard regression over depths, pointer options, ratios and seeds shows no error (TEST-017).
Assertions and coverage live outside the synthesis file list.
Assertions and coverage are disabled.
Assertions do not sample o_rd_data while o_empty is 1.

rules.condition: a request is sampled with an unknown value on an input
rules.statement: An unknown value on an input is flagged as a checker error.
No write is accepted while o_full is 1 (SVA-001).
No read is accepted while o_empty is 1 (SVA-002).
A rejected request changes no pointer (SVA-003).
o_empty is 1 whenever the scoreboard is empty (SVA-004).
o_full is 1 whenever the scoreboard holds DEPTH words (SVA-005).

rules.condition: a write is rejected and unblocked
rules.statement: o_overflow is 1 in the cycle after a rejected, unblocked write and only then (SVA-006).

rules.condition: a read is rejected and unblocked
rules.statement: o_underflow is 1 in the cycle after a rejected, unblocked read and only then (SVA-007).
The word read equals the word written, per scoreboard (SVA-008).
No request is accepted and no pulse is raised while blocked by the software reset (SVA-009).
o_sw_rst_busy is 1 exactly while the write FSM is not in RUN, one cycle behind the state (SVA-010).
The occupancy is between 0 and DEPTH (SVA-011).
Formal analysis is not required in this version; verification is by simulation and assertions.
CDC/RDC analysis is not required because the clocks are synchronous; timed paths are checked by STA (TEST-015).
